name: Kevin McNulty
service_line_reviewed: Article III service reviewed: 2012–13 September 2026. Selected decisions: 1.
record_status_note: 1 decision moved out of scope on 15 September 2026 as criminal subject matter — Ragbir v. United States, a coram nobis proceeding on a civil docket. 2 further decisions are held pending a district-court link. See review/pending/dnj-out-of-scope-criminal/README.md.

biography.text: Born in 1954 in Elizabeth, New Jersey. McNulty earned a B.A. from Yale University (1976) and a J.D. from New York University School of Law (1983). He clerked for U.S. District Judge Frederick B. Lacey, practiced in New York, served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in New Jersey—including as deputy criminal chief and appeals chief—and practiced in Newark. President Obama appointed him in 2012.
